'''Elegasso''' was a minor [[Planet/Legends|planet]] under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a local election was blatantly rigged, drawing the attention of the [[Hand of Judgment]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] team and Imperial agent [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
